en: The postcard features ancient stone ruins and archaeological structures, with a few standing statues and stone markers. Two figures are visible, blending into the historical site. In the background, there is a plain elongated building with a tiled roof. The text printed at the top of the postcard is in both Greek and French. The visual quality and coloration suggest an early 20th-century tinted photograph or hand-colored print.
